title: Lejasmart
description: A web-based expense tracking and business management platform built for local vendors who operate on paper. LejaSmart digitizes the financial record-keeping process — expenses, inventory, sales, and profit & loss — with role-based access for vendors, accountants, and business owners.
role: Solo developer — designed, built, and deployed.
problem: Local vendors and small business owners in informal markets rely on paper ledgers to track their finances, leading to lost records, calculation errors, and no easy way for accountants to review business data remotely.

title: Bitcoin
description: A lightweight Bitcoin blockchain explorer built in Go using Bitcoin Core JSON-RPC. This project was developed in a step-by-step bootcamp style, progressively building from basic RPC calls to a full blockchain inspection tool.
problem: A Lightning Bitcoin Explorer (like Mempool.space's Lightning Dashboard or 1ML) fixes the core problem statement of information asymmetry and lack of structural visibility across Bitcoin's off-chain Layer 2 network.
learned: • The Concept: A Lightning Network relies on peer-to-peer state channels (like HTLCs). You have to keep track of a balance that changes instantly off-chain, while ensuring it can always be securely settled back on the base layer.The Career Value: This teaches you how to manage complex, concurrent application states without relying on a single, slow central database. It is the core foundation needed for building high-frequency trading systems, real-time gaming backends, or collaborative tools.

title: LMS
description: A Learning Management System (LMS) built with Java(springboot) and React, designed to facilitate online education and training. It includes features for course management, user enrollment, progress tracking, and interactive learning experiences.
role: Backend developer — responsible for backend development.
problem: Traditional classroom learning is being replaced by online education, but there is a lack of effective tools for managing and delivering online courses.
learned: • The Concept: An LMS is a software application that enables educators to create, manage, and deliver educational content and track student progress. • The Career Value: This project demonstrates my ability to develop full-stack applications, integrating backend services with frontend interfaces, and understanding the requirements of online education platforms.

title: Pulse
description: A personal finance dashboard that syncs bank transactions via Plaid and surfaces spending trends with Supabase.
role: Solo developer — designed the schema, ETL, and UI.
problem: Budgeting apps buried transactions in charts; I wanted a single view of where money actually went each month.
learned: Supabase RLS is powerful but you must model permissions in the schema, not the UI — otherwise the UI is the only thing standing between a user and everyone else's data.
